senses.gloss: advaya, nt., non-duality, as designation of the Buddhist doctrine. In Mvy 〔1717〕 advayam (Tib. gñis su med pa, non-duality) is listed among paramārtha-paryāyāḥ, synonyms for the true doctrine; advayasaṃjñā udapāsi Mv 〔i.237.14〕, consciousness of non-duality arose in him (so that he resolved to become a Buddha).
Advayavajra, n. of an author: Sādh 〔48.18〕, etc.
advaya-vādin, preaching non-duality, ep. of Buddha: Mvy 〔23〕; Divy 〔95.13〕.
